featured_reviews.name: Anish Tigga
featured_reviews.review_text:
I stayed at Bliss PG (Kasthuri Group) for 1 year and 2 months, and it was a really good experience. The owner, Mr. Prasad Parab, is very supportive and responsive. Whenever there was any issue, he made sure it was resolved quickly, which made the stay very comfortable.

One thing I really appreciated was the cleanliness and maintenance. The rooms and toilets were cleaned every single day, which is something not every PG maintains consistently. The overall service and management were well organized, making it a pleasant place to stay.

Another positive aspect was the friendly and respectful living environment. I had the opportunity to share the room with Saurabh, who was very cooperative and considerate, which contributed to a comfortable and pleasant stay.

If anyone is looking for a well-maintained PG with responsible management, cleanliness, and a positive living environment, I would recommend Bliss PG. Thank you, Mr. Prasad Parab, for providing such a good living experience. Wishing you continued success and many more happy residents!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello,
I have been staying here for two years straight, and it has been a wonderful experience. I have learned a lot. Pooja Bhabhi and her family made me feel like part of her own family. She is very dedicated to her job, even if you call at midnight she will definitely show up. It’s not an easy task to handle and manage people with different lifestyles, but due to all her efforts, it was possible to maintain discipline. My parents were at ease knowing that she (ME) is in safe hands. Bhabhii is a perfect package of loving, caring, and a bit of strictness.

One more thing, please don't pay attention to the negative reviews down there. They're just trying to express their negativity towards the owner by sabotaging her business out of spite due to her strict standards in maintaining the pg.

Now, I would like to share what I have learned over these two years. I feel that God placed me in this PG for a reason. I learned how to deal with different types of people and how to manage them in a polite and humble way. Another important lesson was to focus on the task you came for, regardless of the surroundings.

You can't find such a great place in bustling and vibrant Mumbai. Thank you so much, Bhabhi, for making this journey a memorable one.

From keeping the PG clean everyday with the help of a house help to making sure the interiors are up to the mark, everything is looked after well by the owner Pooja Didi❤️ this was my first experience living in a PG service and I can vouch that it has been worthwhile.
